[SWS_CM_10218] Scope of length field value for structs
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
The serializing SOME/IP network binding shall write the size (in bytes) of the serial-
ized struct (without the size of the length field) into the length field of the struct.
⌋
